reviewNotes: Reviewed tailoring slot names and instructions together, emote labels, separate/shared money notifications and all minigame titles. Named monster substitutions placed in parentheses to avoid guessing gender or grammatical number. All money thresholds and gendered solo earnings preserved. Gem Sea/Junimo/mini-jukebox and monster eradication use glossary terms; unknown stage/results keep deliberate question marks.

Mini_JukeBox_NotFarmPlay.source: The Mini-Jukebox can only be played on your farm!
Mini_JukeBox_NotFarmPlay.translation: Mini-tonomatul poate fi folosit doar la ferma ta!

Mini_JukeBox_OutdoorRainy.source: The Mini-Jukebox cannot be played in the rain!
Mini_JukeBox_OutdoorRainy.translation: Mini-tonomatul nu poate fi folosit în ploaie!

Tailor_MissingIngredients.source: Place cloth or dyeable clothing in the feed and materials in the spool to begin tailoring.
Tailor_MissingIngredients.translation: Pune țesătură sau haine care pot fi vopsite în suport și materiale pe mosor pentru a începe croitoria.

Tailor_Valid.source: Press the power button to begin tailoring!
Tailor_Valid.translation: Apasă butonul de pornire pentru a începe croitoria!

Tailor_InvalidRecipe.source: The current materials cannot be used to tailor an item!
Tailor_InvalidRecipe.translation: Materialele actuale nu pot fi folosite pentru a croi un articol!

Tailor_NotDyeable.source: The clothing item in the feed is not dyeable!
Tailor_NotDyeable.translation: Articolul vestimentar din suport nu poate fi vopsit!

DyePot_Help.source: Place an item of each color into the dye pots in order to dye any dyeable clothes you're wearing.
DyePot_Help.translation: Pune câte un obiect de fiecare culoare în vasele cu vopsea pentru a vopsi hainele pe care le porți și care pot fi vopsite.

DyePot_CanDye.source: Press the Dye button to color your clothes!
DyePot_CanDye.translation: Apasă butonul de vopsire pentru a-ți colora hainele!

DyePot_NoDyeable.source: You aren't wearing any dyeable clothes.
DyePot_NoDyeable.translation: Nu porți haine care pot fi vopsite.

Emote_X.preservationReason: X is the displayed symbol naming this emote.
